notes: First saying («الدرهم بالدرهم ...») is Abu Sa'id's words relayed by Abu Hurayra, so Abu Sa'id is the last link of this route

needs_ruling: the report then has a second saying with its own isnad («أخبرني أسامة بن زيد أن رسول الله قال «إنما الربا في النسيئة»», through ابن عباس, who is asked and answers); it is not read as a route of the first saying
The speaker of «فقلت إني سمعت ابن عباس يقول غير ذلك» is not written in the text; I did not assign him
